persona: Plant HR lead moving into a business-facing HRBP role
resumeText:
Priya Nair | Pune | priya.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Assistant Manager - HR, Sahyadri Auto Components, Pune (2021 - present)
- Partnered with the plant head and three functional heads as their single HR point of contact.
- Built the annual manpower plan for 1,200 employees with the finance team.
- Handled employee relations escalations, including domestic enquiries and grievance committee cases.
- Ran the annual appraisal cycle and rating calibration meetings for 300 staff employees.
- Built monthly attrition dashboards in Power BI for the leadership team.
- Led POSH compliance and internal committee training across two plants.

Senior HR Executive, Indrayani Packaging, Pune (2019 - 2021)
- Managed joining formalities, HR policies and monthly payroll inputs for 400 employees.

SKILLS
Organisation design, Excel, Power BI, Darwinbox

EDUCATION
MBA (HR), Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, 2019
